result:
Root cause: `pieceValSigned` in `engine.inc` returned the material + piece-square value with the colour sign inverted (`and 8 / ret nz` — positive for black, negated for white), so `pstScore` was black-relative while every other eval term is white-relative, and after `eval`'s single side-to-move negation the engine maximised its opponent's material.

Files touched
- `variants/bug04/engine.inc` — the fix: `ret nz` → `ret z` in `pieceValSigned` (+3 comments). One opcode byte; `chess.bin` differs from the pre-fix build in exactly one byte, same length, no addresses shift.
- `variants/bug04/eval_sign_test.py` — new, 8-case regression test driven through `harness/tools/play.py`.
- `variants/bug04/Makefile` — `make test` now runs that test.
- `variants/bug04/chess.bin`, `chess.tap`, `pieces.inc` — rebuilt by `make`.
- `STATE.md`, `FIX_NOTES.md` — workspace root.

Gate status
- Reported symptom gone: PASS. Free queen → `e6d5`, score 953, Matl −10 (was `c7c6` / −90). Free rook → `b3a1`, Matl −3 (was `b3a5` / +1). QQ vs K → score −1786 (was +1766). All three match the report's Expected values.
- `make test`: PASS, 6/6 (golden board, 1.e4 reply, perft, save/load, 128K banked TT, new eval-sign test).
- New test: PASS — 8/8 on the fixed tape, 8/8 fail on a tape rebuilt from the pre-fix binary, each naming the declined capture or the wrong sign. `make` aborts on a failing recipe line, verified, so it is a real gate.
- Characterisation: PASS — 57/57, exit 0 (before the fix: 53 ok / 4 failed, all four in the `search` group).
- Review round: PASS — one synchronous round, "no defect in the fix", gate closed at 1 of 3. The reviewer reconstructed the pre-fix tape itself and re-ran `make test` and characterisation independently rather than trusting my report. No code or test change after the review; the only post-review edits are two factual corrections inside `FIX_NOTES.md`, disclosed there.

Knowingly left open
- 8 non-blocking review findings recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §5 and not actioned, per the termination rule. The one worth a separate bug report: a pre-existing depth-2 quirk (in `4k3/8/8/8/8/8/1q6/R3K3 b` the engine plays a forcing check `b2e5` at depth 2 but the free capture `b2a1` at depths 1/3/4). It is depth-dependent, keeps the correct score sign, loses no material, and matches the pristine-recorded behaviour — so it is not this bug, and "fixing" it would turn characterisation red.
- Pre-fix equivalence is behavioural (60 observation points), not byte identity: the delivered binary was overwritten by the rebuild and cannot be recovered from this workspace.
